evidence.detail: /decks/<any(tournament,league):deck_type>/ route exists but validator allows only [DeckType.ALL, DeckType.LEAGUE]; /decks/tournament/ raises DoesNotExistException
/archetypes/<any(tournament,league):deck_type>/ route exists but validator allows only [DeckType.ALL, DeckType.TOURNAMENT]; /archetypes/league/ raises DoesNotExistException
Decks view has only league_only flag; no tournament_only support in data or view layer for decks
DB schema has deck_type ENUM('league','tournament','other') so data layer can distinguish types; just the application filtering layer is incomplete

triage.notes: This is a subset of #6815 (which adds people pages and a three-way toggle on top). Fixing this specific inconsistency alone (adding tournament filter to /decks/ and league filter to /archetypes/) would touch controllers/metagame.py validator logic, the Decks view, data/deck.py query layer, and the toggle template — roughly 60–100 lines but the correctness of the data queries needs verification.
